description: NaNbO₃ is (Cubic) Perovskite structured and crystallizes in the cubic Pm̅3m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.84 Å. Nb is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NbO₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Nb-O bond lengths are 2.00 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms.
